headline: AMZN Q2 Deep Dive: AI-Driven AWS Growth and Cost Leverage Shape Outlook
summary: Cloud computing and online retail behemoth Amazon (NASDAQ:AMZN) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 19.6% year on year to $200.6 billion. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $199.5 billion was less impressive, coming in 2.1% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $5.75 per share was significantly above analysts’ consensus estimates.
